texts.name: Dignar
texts.biography: Dignar was raised among hobbits, despite being a dwarf himself. He was found in the forest as an infant and never met his dwarven parents. Now old, he still has a sharp mind and agile body. He teaches the hobbits how to use a sling.

specialty.description: Increases the speed of Hobbits and Battle hobbits by 1 and their attack and defense by 10% per experience level.
specialty.name: Hobbits
